name: praleye-monorepo
description: Praleye - Autonomous Multi-Hazard Disaster Intelligence, OSINT Rescue Geolocation & Tactical Command Platform for India

scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');" && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "uvicorn --app-dir backend main:app --reload --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: pytest backend/tests/ -v && npm --prefix frontend run test
